_note: DEMO FIXTURE: illustrative sample for UI development.
objective: [Fixture] Estimate directional late-night café demand among residents of Neighborhoods A and B.
targetSegment: [Fixture] Adults 21-45 living in or near Neighborhood A or B who are out after 10 PM at least occasionally.

questions.text: Which neighborhood do you live closest to?
In a typical week, how often are you looking for somewhere to sit and eat or drink after 10 PM?
How likely would you be to visit a café open until 2 AM within a 10-minute walk?
What would you typically expect to spend on one late-night café visit?
What, if anything, would make a late-night café worth visiting for you?

neutralityNotes: [Fixture] Questions avoid naming a preferred neighborhood and use balanced scales.
